title: “Dream Makers” gonna make you mad
content: Hello fellow MW dreamers. When I was 4yrs old, I had a dream that has stuck with me til this day(I’m now in my 30s). I want to know if anyone has experienced anything similar? Even though I was just 4, if I focused, I was able to change my dream or control certain aspects. I guess it’s called “lucid dreaming”, but as a kid, I just assumed this was how dreams worked for everyone. One night while trying to change my dream, it didn’t work and I found myself in this strange place. Similar to what is pictured above. It was like the inside of a tower/science lab. I had a very intense feeling in my entire body that I wasn’t supposed to be there. In a panic, I kept trying very hard to change the dream or wake up, but it wouldn’t work. There were two non-human creatures standing and talking to each other at a stone alter/counter. One was yellowish and had a toad shaped head but human like body and wore a robe. The other creature was shorter and had more of an ant shaped head and was also in a robe. The counter was covered with beakers and papers and all the pipes and tubes around the room led to it. The pipes went all around the room and I tried to hide behind one, but the toad like creature sensed I was there and called me out. They asked me how I got there. I told them I didn’t know. I asked who they were and they looked at each other. The toad guy said, “We are the dream makers and if you tell anyone about what you’ve seen, something very bad will happen to your family. Do you understand?” I asked them not to hurt me or my family and if I could watch them make a dreams but they ignored me. The toad creature then told me that that he would be around my entire life, but I would never see him or visit that place again. He then said he was sending me back. He said something I didn’t understand over me and I woke up. I have never had a dream about that place or those creatures again. When I think about that dream I still feel weird and don’t even know how I would have come up with that at that at age. Maybe I was just super imaginative. Anyone else?
